_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for defilers-and-friends, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write from the committed data.js gives the same data.js again). The list was built from its New Recruit PDF (verify/sources/nr/defilers-and-friends.txt) and is rebuilt from the owner’s newer JSON exports (25 Oct 2026, then Defilers_and_friends_2.json: Lucius the Eternal, a Sorcerer, two Maulerfiends and a Chaos Rhino in place of Fulgrim and one Daemon Prince); the hand work of the units that stay is carried over as signed off, and the readings of the units that come back (Lucius the Eternal and Flawless Blades, the Maulerfiend) are the ones the PDF-built list had, signed off then. Coterie of the Conceited is in data.js already (its gists, mods, defs and the rule’s footnote stay there: no gists or rules here). units: per unit entry, its abilities’ When targeted lines (def, AI-written, with defOf), its weapon footnotes (mods), its auras (only what GW tags (Aura), Core Rules 22.01: none of this list gives friendly units anything). Each is a judgement verify/helpers.js lists for sign-off.
